entries.text: Fix the failing tests in tests/test_cli.py
Two tests failed because `rig status` printed the workers before the parent line. I swapped the order and left the rest of the output as it was.

src/cli.py +2 −2
@@ -118,4 +118,4 @@
-    for name, state in workers.items():
-        print(f"worker: {name} ({state})")
     print(f"parent: {parent}")
+    for name, state in workers.items():
+        print(f"worker: {name} ({state})")
